Quick telemetry summary from the 15:00–16:30 PST window:
- Error spike correlates with ~3x increase in model-variant fallback events (requests falling back to higher-compute variant due to cache KV evictions).
- Autoscaling triggered multiple cold-starts when concurrent sessions exceeded the burst threshold; the scheduling window then caused queueing and increased P99.
- Batching scheduler hit a regression in the latest runtime (v2.8.1) under certain sequence-length distributions leading to requeued requests.

Immediate mitigations we can apply within the hour (non-disruptive):
1) Pin the customer to the pre-regression variant (v2.7.9) for their critical routes — will avoid the batching regression. (Owner: infra ops)
2) Temporarily raise reserved capacity for their Dedicated pool by +20% (Owner: capacity ops) — reduces cold starts.
3) Turn off aggressive prefix-KV eviction for the customer (Owner: runtime team) — reduces fallbacks.
4) If those do not restore healthy levels within 45–60m, plan a controlled rollback of the runtime patch for affected nodes.

I’ve attached a CSV snapshot of request/err counts and a short MP with proposed action owners. ETA for item 1–3: 20–35 minutes once we have bridge and approvals.

Karthik
